answer: To maintain anti-Sybil equilibrium, super-linear marginal attack costs ensure that the quadratic staking erosion or liquidity-sink commitments required for each additional validator disproportionately exceed the potential extracted value. This mechanism inherently safeguards against Sybil attacks, exemplified by the jetty metaphor where each additional pier (validator) bears exponentially greater costs, far surpassing the value of ivory or marble transported.
